headline: Operating and net profit slip from last year
summary_short: Consolidated operating profit was KRW 1,274B, down 4.5% y/y from KRW 1,334B, and controlling net income was KRW 1.01T versus KRW 1.10T.
summary_long: A third-party earnings summary puts consolidated operating profit at KRW 1,274B against KRW 1,334B a year earlier, and controlling net income at KRW 1.01T against KRW 1.10T. Yahoo EPS of KRW 1,341 compares with KRW 2,044 a year ago. No consolidated revenue figure was found. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Operating profit and net income come from one third-party summary snippet. Consolidated revenue was not found; the shard revenue and operating income look like parent-only figures and are not used. EPS is Yahoo data and may be on a different basis.
